question: What a supply dump costs under each option

series.label: CP from charts, stores from text (option 3)

finding: The options agree on a real dump's CP and differ on a dummy's CP (3 or 2) and a real dump's stores (20 or 10; stores count only in the Logistics Game). 10 real dumps and 5 dummies cost option 1: 45 CP and 200 stores; option 2: 40 CP and 100 stores; option 3: 40 CP and 200 stores.
